landing.headline: A SaaS scaffold on SvelteKit, Prisma and daisyUI.
landing.subline: Route groups for the app, the auth flows and the legal pages — plus the handful of components they are built from. Start anywhere:

entries.label: App
entries.text: Dashboard, team, billing, profile and settings behind a collapsible sidebar.

entries.label: Auth
entries.text: Sign in, sign up and the two password flows — validated on the server.

entries.label: Components
entries.text: Every element with the props that produce each variant.

entries.label: Tasks
entries.text: List with search, filters, sorting and paging — all of it in the URL.

entries.label: Content
entries.text: Privacy, terms and imprint, written as markdown via mdsvex.

authPanel.headline: The boring parts of a SaaS, already built.

highlights.title: Ship on day one
highlights.text: Routing, forms and validation are wired up and work without JavaScript.

highlights.title: Safe by default
highlights.text: Every mutation goes through a typed remote function on the server.

highlights.title: Yours to shape
highlights.text: A handful of elements and a theme — no framework on top of the framework.
